            has_variable = zg361_review_serial

        if = {

            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_ah_expected value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_expected value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_ah_completed value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_completed value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_digest_shown value = 0 }
            remove_variable = zg361_cl_digest_pending
            every_vassal = {
                limit = {
                    zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
                    liege = root
                }
                zg361_cl_open_ah_case_effect = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_cl_open_ah_applied = 1 }
                    root = { change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_ah_expected add = 1 } }
                }
                zg361_cl_open_ai_case_effect = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_cl_open_ai_applied = 1 }
                    root = { change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_expected add = 1 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 312 } }
}

# 312 market.publish_real_vacancy
zg361_cl_m312_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m312_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 312
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_kind_id value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_reporting_manager value = var:zg361_cl_m312_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_candidate value = var:zg361_cl_m312_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.812 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.812 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.812 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m312_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 312 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 312 } }
    }
}

# 312 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m312_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m312_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_legal_hc value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_reporting_line_frozen value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_pay_band_frozen value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_goal_frozen value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_eligible_scope value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_hire_limit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_filled_n value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_market_trust_delta value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m312_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_legal_hc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_eligible_scope value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_market_trust_delta value = -2 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m312_market_trust_delta }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 312 market.publish_real_vacancy"
    }
}

# 312 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m312_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m312_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m312_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m312_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m312_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m312_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m312_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m312_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 312 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m312_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m312_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 312 vacancy obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m312_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m312_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 313 market.freeze_structured_reference
zg361_cl_m313_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m313_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m313_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 313
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_kind_id value = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_source_manager value = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_reference_candidate value = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.813 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.813 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.813 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m313_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 313 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 313 } }
    }
}

# 313 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m313_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m313_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m313_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_achievements_frozen value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_risks_frozen value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_pip_link_frozen value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_handover_frozen value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_omitted_material value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_retaliatory_whisper value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_whitewash_audit value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_anti_retaliation_audit value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m313_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_omitted_material value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_retaliatory_whisper value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_whitewash_audit value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_anti_retaliation_audit value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m313_whitewash_audit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m313_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m313_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 313 market.freeze_structured_reference"
    }
}

# 313 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m313_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m313_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m313_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m313_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m313_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m313_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m313_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m313_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m313_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m313_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m313_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 313 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 313 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_reference_review_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m313_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m313_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m313_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m313_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 313 reference obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m313_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m313_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 314 market.offer_relocation_package
zg361_cl_m314_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ah_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 15
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_dual_payment_ready value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_available value = 15 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_case
                    AMOUNT = 15
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status
                }
            }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_manager_available value = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_manager_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_manager_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_manager_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_case
                    AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status = 2
                var:zg361_cl_m314_manager_status = 2
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            # No business receipt exists yet.  Undo either shadow journal so
            # a later retry sees a clean dual-payer transaction.
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
    }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m314_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 314
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_deferred value = 0 }
                if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ah_owner = {
                    remove_treasury = 15
                    add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_total_cost value = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_share value = 15 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_manager_share value = 5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_dual_payment_settled value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_total_cost value = 0 }
            }
                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_kind_id value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_target_manager value = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_offered_official value = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.814 days = 190 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.814 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m314_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {
                # The shadow journals settled before the business receipt.  If the
                # receipt unexpectedly loses its frozen guard, undo both journals;
                # no CK3 gold has been deducted yet and the same ticket may retry.
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_treasury_status
                }
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m314_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_manager_status
                }
            }
                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 314 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 314 } }
    }
}

# 314 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m314_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 2
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m314_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_accepted value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_declined value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_response_once value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_lump_sum value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_temporary_allowance value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_family_support value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_allowance_end_day value = 190 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_allowance_active value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_performance_delta value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m314_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_accepted value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_allowance_active value = 1 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_declined value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m314_accepted }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m314_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m314_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 314 market.offer_relocation_package"
    }
}

# 314 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m314_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m314_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m314_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m314_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m314_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m314_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 314 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 314 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_allowance_active value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m314_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m314_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m314_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 314 transfer_offer obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m314_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m314_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# Assessed count/baron self-response.  It grants no manager or case authority.
zg361_cl_m314_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m314_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m314_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 314 once"
    }
}

# 315 market.run_bilateral_trial
zg361_cl_m315_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m315_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 315
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_kind_id value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_trial_target_manager value = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_trial_official value = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.815 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.815 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.815 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m315_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 315 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 315 } }
    }
}

# 315 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m315_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 2
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m315_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_trial_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_source_credit_share value = 40 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_target_credit_share value = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_credit_sum value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_employee_exit_right value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_source_exit_right value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_target_exit_right value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_returned_to_source value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_failed_is_low_grade value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m315_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_returned_to_source value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m315_returned_to_source }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m315_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m315_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 315 market.run_bilateral_trial"
    }
}

# 315 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m315_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m315_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m315_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m315_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m315_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m315_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 315 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 315 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
