        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_trial_resolved value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m315_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m315_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m315_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 315 trial_assignment obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m315_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m315_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# Assessed count/baron self-response.  It grants no manager or case authority.
zg361_cl_m315_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m315_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m315_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 315 once"
    }
}

# 316 market.freeze_pay_mapping
zg361_cl_m316_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m316_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 316
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_kind_id value = 5 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_pay_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m316_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_mapped_official value = var:zg361_cl_m316_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.816 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.816 days = 365 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m316_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 316 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 316 } }
    }
}

# 316 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m316_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 3
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m316_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_mapping_frozen_before_accept value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_professional_base value = 30 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_source_allowance value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_target_allowance value = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_method value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_step_1 value = 38 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_step_2 value = 36 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_step_3 value = 35 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_historical_payments_immutable value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m316_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_method value = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_step_1 value = 35 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m316_method }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 316 market.freeze_pay_mapping"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m316_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m316_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 316 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_pay_mapping_settled value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m316_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m316_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 316 pay_mapping obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m316_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m316_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 317 market.project_stage_acl
zg361_cl_m317_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 317
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_kind_id value = 6 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_applicant value = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_days value = 7 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.817 days = 7 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_days value = 7 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.817 days = 7 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m317_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 317 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 317 } }
    }
}

# 317 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m317_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 3
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_stage value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_authorized_viewers value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_access_log_rows value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_leaked_to_source value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_rating_changed_without_evidence value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_anti_retaliation_audit value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_authorized_viewers value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_leaked_to_source value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_rating_changed_without_evidence value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_anti_retaliation_audit value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m317_anti_retaliation_audit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 317 market.project_stage_acl"
    }
}

# 317 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m317_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 317 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_review_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 317 application_acl obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m317_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m317_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 318 }

                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice

                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route

                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }

                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_kind_id value = 7 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_quota_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m318_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_applicant value = var:zg361_cl_m318_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_days value = 14 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.818 days = 14 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_days value = 14 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.818 days = 14 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m318_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 318 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 318 } }
    }
}

# 318 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m318_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 2
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m318_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m318_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_formal_limit value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_formal_used value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_withdrawal_still_consumes value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_exploratory_consumes value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_manager_timeout_refunds value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m318_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_formal_used value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_manager_timeout_refunds value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_formal_remaining value = { value = 2 subtract = var:zg361_cl_m318_formal_used } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m318_formal_remaining }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 318 market.consume_application_slot"
    }
}

# 318 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m318_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 318 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m318_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m318_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m318_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m318_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m318_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m318_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m318_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m318_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m318_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m318_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 318 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m318_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 318 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_slot_timeout_settled value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m318_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m318_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 318 application_quota obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m318_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m318_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# Assessed count/baron self-response.  It grants no manager or case authority.
zg361_cl_m318_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m318_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m318_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 318 once"
    }
}

# 319 market.counteroffer_then_release
zg361_cl_m319_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 319
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_kind_id value = 8 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_releasing_manager value = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_released_official value = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.819 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.819 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_days value = 45 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.819 days = 45 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m319_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 319 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 319 } }
    }

# 319 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m319_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 4
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_counteroffer_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_counteroffer_limit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_release_deadline_days value = 30 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_deadline_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_released_on_time value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_fulfilled value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_released_on_time value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_fulfilled value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_pending value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 319 market.counteroffer_then_release"
    }
}

# 319 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m319_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m319_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 319 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 319 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_release_or_promise_checked value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_promise_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_manager_talent_delta value = -20 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m319_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 319 release_obligation obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m319_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m319_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# Assessed count/baron self-response.  It grants no manager or case authority.
zg361_cl_m319_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m319_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m319_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 319 once"
    }
}

# 320 market.aggregate_exit_voice
zg361_cl_m320_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m320_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m320_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 320
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_kind_id value = 9 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_aggregate_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m320_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_exit_official value = var:zg361_cl_m320_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_days value = 180 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.820 days = 180 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_days value = 180 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.820 days = 180 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_days value = 180 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.820 days = 180 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m320_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 320 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 320 } }
    }
}

# 320 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m320_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 5
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m320_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m320_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_named_n value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_anonymous_n value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_declined_n value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_minimum_same_issue_sample value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_same_issue_n value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_audit_triggered value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_anonymous_identity_hidden value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_original_reason_preserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_reclassification_rows value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m320_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_reclassification_rows value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m320_audit_triggered }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 320 market.aggregate_exit_voice"
    }
}

            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_resolved value = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_aggregate_audit_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m320_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m320_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 320 exit_signal obligation"
    }
}
