# 325 learning.assess_practical_competence
zg361_cl_m325_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m325_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 325
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_kind_id value = 14 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_training_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m325_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_assessed_official value = var:zg361_cl_m325_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.825 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.825 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.825 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m325_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 325 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 325 } }
    }
}

# 325 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m325_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m325_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_certificate_passed value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_practical_score value = 30 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_practical_threshold value = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_test_valid value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_competent value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_training_owner_audit value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_automatic_low_grade value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m325_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_test_valid value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_training_owner_audit value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m325_competent }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 325 learning.assess_practical_competence"
    }
}

# 325 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m325_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m325_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m325_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m325_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m325_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m325_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m325_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m325_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 325 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_practical_assessment_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m325_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m325_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 325 competence_assessment obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m325_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m325_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 326 learning.settle_conference_adoption
zg361_cl_m326_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m326_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ai_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 9
                    gold >= 3
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_dual_payment_ready value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_available value = 9 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_case
                    AMOUNT = 9
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status
                }
            }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_manager_available value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_manager_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_manager_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_manager_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_case
                    AMOUNT = 3
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status = 2
                var:zg361_cl_m326_manager_status = 2
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            # No business receipt exists yet.  Undo either shadow journal so
            # a later retry sees a clean dual-payer transaction.
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
    }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m326_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 326
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_deferred value = 0 }
                if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ai_owner = {
                    remove_treasury = 9
                    add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 3 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_total_cost value = 12 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_share value = 9 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_manager_share value = 3 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_dual_payment_settled value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_total_cost value = 0 }
            }
                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_kind_id value = 15 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_conference_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m326_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_delegate value = var:zg361_cl_m326_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.826 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.826 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.826 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m326_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {
                # The shadow journals settled before the business receipt.  If the
                # receipt unexpectedly loses its frozen guard, undo both journals;
                # no CK3 gold has been deducted yet and the same ticket may retry.
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_treasury_status
                }
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m326_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_manager_status
                }
            }
                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 326 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 326 } }
    }
}

# 326 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m326_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 2
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m326_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m326_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_days_away value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_artifact_adopted value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_adopted_value value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_reputation_gain value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_delivery_opportunity_cost value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_attrition_risk value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m326_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_artifact_adopted value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_adopted_value value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m326_adopted_value }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 326 learning.settle_conference_adoption"
    }
}

# 326 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m326_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m326_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m326_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m326_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m326_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m326_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m326_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m326_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m326_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m326_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m326_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m326_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 326 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m326_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 326 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_adoption_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m326_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m326_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m326_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 326 conference_adoption obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m326_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m326_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 327 learning.attribute_teaching_impact
zg361_cl_m327_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m327_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m327_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 327
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_kind_id value = 16 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_application_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_teacher value = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.827 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.827 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.827 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m327_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 327 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 327 } }
    }
}

# 327 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m327_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 2
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m327_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m327_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_teaching_hours value = 8 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_available_hours value = 40 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_remaining_hours value = 32 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_attendees value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_applying_attendees value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_teacher_share value = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_applicator_share value = 40 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_share_sum value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_performance_credit value = 6 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m327_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_applying_attendees value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_performance_credit value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m327_performance_credit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m327_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m327_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 327 learning.attribute_teaching_impact"
    }
}

# 327 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m327_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m327_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m327_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m327_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m327_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m327_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m327_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m327_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m327_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m327_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m327_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 327 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 327 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_teaching_application_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m327_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m327_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m327_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m327_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 327 teaching_attribution obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m327_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m327_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 328 learning.settle_community_adoption
zg361_cl_m328_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m328_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 328
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_kind_id value = 17 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_community_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m328_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_maintainer value = var:zg361_cl_m328_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.828 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.828 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.828 days = 90 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m328_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 328 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 328 } }
    }

            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_choice

    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 3
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m328_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_artifacts value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_maintainers value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_available_hours value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_contribution_hours value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_capacity_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_adopting_teams value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_cross_team_impact value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m328_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_adopting_teams value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_cross_team_impact value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m328_cross_team_impact }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 328 learning.settle_community_adoption"
    }
}
