        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m328_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m328_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m328_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 328 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m328_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 328 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_community_maintenance_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m328_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m328_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m328_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 328 community_artifact obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m328_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m328_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 329 learning.match_cross_team_mentor
zg361_cl_m329_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 329
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_kind_id value = 18 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_cl_mentor_subject
                var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner = {
                    random_vassal = {
                        limit = {
                            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
                            NOT = { this = scope:zg361_cl_mentor_subject }
                        }
                        save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_cl_external_mentor
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:zg361_cl_external_mentor }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor value = scope:zg361_cl_external_mentor }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct value = 1 }
                }
                else = {
                    # A missing distinct mentor is an observable negative object,
                    # never a fabricated successful cross-team match.
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_missing value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct value = 0 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentee value = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.829 days = 190 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.829 days = 190 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 190 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.829 days = 190 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m329_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 329 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 329 } }
    }
}

# 329 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m329_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 3
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_active_mentor_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_goal_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_committed_hours value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_capacity_payment value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deadline_before value = 190 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_deadline_after value = 190 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_rematch_limit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_rematch_used value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_application_evidence value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_rematch_used value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_active_mentor_count value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_application_evidence value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_match_failed value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 329 learning.match_cross_team_mentor"
    }
}

# 329 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m329_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m329_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m329_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 329 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 329 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_match_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_route = 1 var:zg361_cl_m329_mentor_distinct = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_application_evidence value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_mentor_credit value = 1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m329_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m329_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m329_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 329 mentor_match obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m329_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m329_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 330 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ai_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 15
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 330 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_dual_payment_ready value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_available value = 15 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_case
                    AMOUNT = 15
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status
                }
            }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_manager_available value = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_manager_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_manager_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_manager_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_case
                    AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status = 2
                var:zg361_cl_m330_manager_status = 2
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            # No business receipt exists yet.  Undo either shadow journal so
            # a later retry sees a clean dual-payer transaction.
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
    }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 330
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_deferred value = 0 }
                if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ai_owner = {
                    remove_treasury = 15
                    add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_total_cost value = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_share value = 15 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_manager_share value = 5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_dual_payment_settled value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_total_cost value = 0 }
            }
                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_kind_id value = 19 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_target_role_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_affected_official value = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.830 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.830 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_days value = 180 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.830 days = 180 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m330_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {
                # The shadow journals settled before the business receipt.  If the
                # receipt unexpectedly loses its frozen guard, undo both journals;
                # no CK3 gold has been deducted yet and the same ticket may retry.
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_treasury_status
                }
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m330_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_manager_status
                }
            }
                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 330 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 330 } }
    }
}

# 330 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m330_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 4
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_route_code value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_affected_character_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_target_role_count value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_training_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_assessment_score value = 50 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_threshold value = 70 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_placed value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_failed_is_low_grade value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_fairness_debt value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_role_identity_conserved value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_route_code value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_fairness_debt value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m330_placed }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 330 learning.settle_reskill_route"
    }
}

# 330 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m330_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 330 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m330_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m330_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m330_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 330 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 330 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_reskill_assessment_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m330_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m330_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m330_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 330 reskill_case obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m330_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m330_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 331 learning.borrow_protected_time
zg361_cl_m331_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        OR = {
                                            scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                                            scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                                        }
                                    }
                                    OR = {
                                        is_at_war = yes
                                        var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { is_at_war = yes }
                                    }
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 331
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_kind_id value = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_capacity_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m331_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_learner value = var:zg361_cl_m331_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.831 days = 365 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.831 days = 365 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.831 days = 365 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m331_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 331 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 331 } }
    }
}

# 331 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m331_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 4
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m331_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_total_capacity value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_protected_hours value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_borrowed_hours value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_delivery_hours value = 94 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_real_crisis_required value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_repayment_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_repaid_hours value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_manager_score_delta value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_capacity_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m331_manager_score_delta }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 331 learning.borrow_protected_time"
    }
}

# 331 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m331_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m331_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m331_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 331 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m331_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 331 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_protected_time_repayment_checked value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_repaid_hours value = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_manager_score_delta value = -10 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m331_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m331_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 331 protected_time_loan obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m331_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m331_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 332 learning.run_safe_succession_drill
zg361_cl_m332_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m332_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 332
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_kind_id value = 21 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_incumbent value = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_successor_candidate value = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.832 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.832 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.832 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m332_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 332 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 332 } }
    }
}

# 332 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m332_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 5
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m332_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_safe_simulation value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_readiness_before value = 40 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_readiness_after value = 50 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_success value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_emergency_veto_limit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_emergency_veto_used value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_development_gap value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_real_incident value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_automatic_low_grade value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m332_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_readiness_after value = 42 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_success value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_emergency_veto_used value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_development_gap value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m332_readiness_after }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m332_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m332_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 332 learning.run_safe_succession_drill"
    }
}

# 332 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m332_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_object_owner
