                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m332_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m332_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m332_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m332_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m332_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 332 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_succession_drill_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m332_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m332_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m332_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m332_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 332 succession_drill obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m332_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m332_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 333 learning.settle_training_commitment
zg361_cl_m333_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ai_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 18
                    gold >= 6
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_dual_payment_ready value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_available value = 18 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_case
                    AMOUNT = 18
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status
                }
            }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_manager_available value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_manager_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_manager_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_manager_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_case
                    AMOUNT = 6
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status = 2
                var:zg361_cl_m333_manager_status = 2
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            # No business receipt exists yet.  Undo either shadow journal so
            # a later retry sees a clean dual-payer transaction.
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
    }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 333
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_deferred value = 0 }
                if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ai_owner = {
                    remove_treasury = 18
                    add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 6 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_total_cost value = 24 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_share value = 18 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_manager_share value = 6 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_dual_payment_settled value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_total_cost value = 0 }
            }
                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_kind_id value = 22 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_contract_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_bound_official value = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_days value = 360 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.833 days = 360 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.833 days = 90 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m333_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {
                # The shadow journals settled before the business receipt.  If the
                # receipt unexpectedly loses its frozen guard, undo both journals;
                # no CK3 gold has been deducted yet and the same ticket may retry.
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_treasury_status
                }
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m333_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_manager_status
                }
            }
                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 333 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 333 } }
    }
}

# 333 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m333_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 5
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m333_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_training_cost value = 24 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_completion_day value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_service_end_day value = 460 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_monthly_reduction value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_months_served value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_recovery_cap value = 24 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_outstanding value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_application_evidence value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_performance_credit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_organization_layoff_exempt value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_outstanding value = 18 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_application_evidence value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_performance_credit value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_organization_layoff_exempt value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m333_performance_credit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 333 learning.settle_training_commitment"
    }
}

# 333 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m333_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m333_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m333_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m333_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m333_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m333_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 333 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 333 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route = 2 }
            zg361_cl_m333_layoff_exemption_effect = yes
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled = 0 }
                zg361_cl_m333_recover_outstanding_effect = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_training_service_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
            }
            else = {
                # Insufficient personal funds leave the obligation pending and
                # retryable; no recovery or resolved receipt is fabricated.
                trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.833 days = 30 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_training_service_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            } }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 333 training_commitment obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m333_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m333_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# Assessed count/baron self-response.  It grants no manager or case authority.
zg361_cl_m333_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 333 once"
    }
}

zg361_cl_run_ah_stage_01_effect = {
    # Revalidate the frozen case and live authority even when every mechanism
    # receipt was written early and the core calls below will all be skipped.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 312 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ah_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ah_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 312 }
        zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_01_effect = yes
    }
    else = {
    if = {
            limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
        RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
        RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
        RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
        RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
        RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_state
        RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
        EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
        EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
    } } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m312_subject_response }
                zg361_cl_m312_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = var:zg361_cl_m312_subject_response
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$

            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_02_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            # A failed transition leaves the frozen stage retryable.
            zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_01_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        # A resource RED leaves the bounded case open and retries the same
        # frozen stage; it never skips the unpaid mechanism or mints a receipt.
        zg361_cl_schedule_ah_stage_01_effect = yes
    }
    }
}

            TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            zg361_cl_schedule_ai_stage_02_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            # A failed transition leaves the frozen stage retryable.
            zg361_cl_schedule_ai_stage_01_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        # A resource RED leaves the bounded case open and retries the same
        # frozen stage; it never skips the unpaid mechanism or mints a receipt.
        zg361_cl_schedule_ai_stage_01_effect = yes
    }
    }
}

                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 332 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 332 }
        zg361_cl_schedule_ai_stage_05_effect = yes
    }
    else = {
    if = {
            limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
        RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
        RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
        RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
        RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
        RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_state
        RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
        EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
        EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
    } } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m332_subject_response }
                zg361_cl_m332_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = var:zg361_cl_m332_subject_response
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
            }
            else = {
                zg361_cl_m332_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = 1
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
            }
        }
    if = {
            limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
        RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
        RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
        RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
        RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
        RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
        RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
        EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
        EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
    } } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m333_subject_response }
                zg361_cl_m333_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = var:zg361_cl_m333_subject_response
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
            }
            else = {
                zg361_cl_m333_core_effect = {
                    ROUTE = 1
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                }
            }
        }

    if = {
        limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
			    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_owner
			    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_subject
			    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_cycle
			    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_case
			    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_state
			    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
			    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m332_receipt_choice
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
			    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
			    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
			    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
			    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
			    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
			    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
			    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
			}

        }
        zg361_case_ai_advance_05_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
            TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            zg361_cl_queue_owner_digest_effect = { OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner COUNTER = zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_completed CASE_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
        }
        else = {
            # A failed transition leaves the frozen stage retryable.
            zg361_cl_schedule_ai_stage_05_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        # A resource RED leaves the bounded case open and retries the same
        # frozen stage; it never skips the unpaid mechanism or mints a receipt.
        zg361_cl_schedule_ai_stage_05_effect = yes
    }
    }
}

# Exactly one portfolio digest can be queued per review serial.  It waits for
# both domains across all frozen direct reports, so late deadlines cannot turn
# one portfolio into a second popup.
zg361_cl_queue_owner_digest_effect = {
    # Freeze the source case cycle before changing into the owner scope; effect
    # parameters are textual and must not be re-read against the owner character.
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_cl_completion_cycle
        value = $CASE_CYCLE$
    }
    var:$OWNER_VAR$ = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = zg361_cl_portfolio_cycle
                var:zg361_cl_portfolio_cycle = scope:zg361_cl_completion_cycle
            }
            change_variable = { name = $COUNTER$ add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_ai = no
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_portfolio_ah_expected > 0
                        var:zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_expected > 0
                    }
                    var:zg361_cl_portfolio_ah_completed >= var:zg361_cl_portfolio_ah_expected
                    var:zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_completed >= var:zg361_cl_portfolio_ai_expected
                    var:zg361_cl_portfolio_digest_shown = 0
                    NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_digest_pending }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_digest_pending value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_portfolio_digest_shown value = 1 }
                trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.390 days = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { is_ai = yes }
                debug_log = "ZG361CL: eligible AI career/learning portfolio advanced silently"
            }
        }
        else = { debug_log = "ZG361CL: stale portfolio completion ignored" }
    }
}

# A single legal hire consumes the vacancy.  A second call is a typed duplicate.
zg361_cl_m312_hire_once_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice
}
            var:zg361_cl_m312_legal_hc = 1
            var:zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_filled_n = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_filled_n value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m312_hired_subject value = this }
    }
    else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 312 } }
}

# Organization layoff cancels only the outstanding recovery; it cannot erase
# the original training receipt or manufacture performance credit.
zg361_cl_m333_layoff_exemption_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_subject
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_cycle
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_case
    EXPECTED_STATE = 5
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route
}
            var:zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled = 0
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_actual_exit
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_reason
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_subject
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_treasury_paid
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_personal_received
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_hc_released
            has_variable = zg361_b2_m074_state
            var:zg361_b2_m074_actual_exit = 1
            var:zg361_b2_m074_reason = 1
            var:zg361_b2_m074_subject = this
            var:zg361_b2_m074_treasury_paid = 50
            var:zg361_b2_m074_personal_received = 50
            var:zg361_b2_m074_hc_released = 1
            OR = {
                var:zg361_b2_m074_state = 3
                var:zg361_b2_m074_state = 4
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_organization_layoff_exempt value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_outstanding value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled value = 1 }
    }
}

# Voluntary early exit returns the D+90 outstanding amount to the original
# treasury/personal split.  18 <= original 24; the latch makes recovery once-only.
zg361_cl_m333_recover_outstanding_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m333_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_subject
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_cycle
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_case
    EXPECTED_STATE = 5
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m333_object_route
}
            var:zg361_cl_m333_organization_layoff_exempt = 0
            var:zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled = 0
            var:zg361_cl_m333_outstanding = 18
            gold >= 18
        }
        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 18 }
        var:zg361_cl_m333_object_owner = {
            add_treasury = 13
            add_gold = 5
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_recovered value = 18 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m333_recovery_settled value = 1 }
    }
    else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 333 } }
}
